arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ إذا ذُكِرَ الشيطان فَاستَعاذَ مِنهُِ
english_title: 17. When he Mentioned Satan and Sought Refuge from him

phrases.english: 1.O God, we seek refuge in You

phrases.arabic: مِنْ نَزَغَـاتِ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَكَيْدِهِ وَمَكَائِدِهِ،
phrases.english: 2.from the instigations of the accursed Satan, his trickery, and his traps,

phrases.arabic: وَمِنَ الثِّقَةِ بِأَمَـانِيِّهِ وَمَوَاعِيدِهِ وَغُرُورِهِ وَمَصَائِدِهِ،
phrases.english: 3.from trust in his false hopes, his promises, his delusions, and his snares,
4.and lest he should make himself crave to lead us away
5.from Your obedience and to degrade us through our disobeying You,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ أَنْ يَحْسُنَ عِنْدَنَا مَا حَسَّنَ لَنَا،
phrases.english: 6.and lest what he has shown us as beautiful be beautiful for us

phrases.arabic: أَوْ أَنْ يَثْقُلَ عَلَيْنَا مَا كَرَّهَ إلَيْنَا.
phrases.english: 7.and what he has shown us as detestable weigh down upon us.
8.O God, drive him away from us through Your worship,
9.throw him down through our perseverance in Your love,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ سِتْراً لاَ يَهْتِكُهُ،
phrases.english: 10.and place between him and us a covering that he cannot tear away
11.and a solid barrier that he cannot cut through!
12.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
13.distract Satan from us with some of Your enemies,

phrases.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنَا مِنْهُ بِحُسْنِ رِعَايَتِكَ، وَاكْفِنَا خَتْرَهُ،
phrases.english: 14.preserve us from him through Your good guarding, spare us his treachery,
15.turn his back toward us, and cut off from us his trace!
16.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
17.give us to enjoy guidance the like of his misguidance,
18.increase us in piety against his seduction,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْلُكْ بِنَـا مِنَ التُّقى خِـلافَ سَبِيلِهِ مِنَ الـرَّدى.
phrases.english: 19.and make us walk in reverential fear contrary to his path of ruin!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لَهُ فِي قُلُوبِنَا مَدْخَلاً
phrases.english: 20.O God, assign him no place of entrance into our hearts

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تُوطِنَنَّ لَهُ فِيمَا لَدَيْنَا مَنْزِلاً.
phrases.english: 21.and do not allow him to make his home in that which is with us!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ وَمَا سَوَّلَ لَنَا مِنْ بَاطِل فَعَرِّفْنَاهُ
phrases.english: 22.O God, cause us to recognize the falsehood with which he tempts us,

phrases.arabic: وَإذَا عَرَّفْتَنَاهُ فَقِنَاهُ، وَبَصِّرْنَا مَا نُكَايِدُهُ بِهِ،
phrases.english: 23.and once You hast caused us to recognize it, protect us from it! Make us see what will allow us to outwit him,

phrases.arabic: وَأَلْهِمْنَا مَا نُعِدُّهُ لَهُ، وَأَيْقِظْنَا عَنْ سِنَةِ الْغَفْلَةِ بِالرُّكُونِ إلَيْهِ
phrases.english: 24.inspire us with all that we can make ready for him, awaken us from the heedless slumber of relying upon him,
25.and help us well, through Your giving success, against him!
26.O God, saturate our hearts with the rejection of his works
27.and be gentle to us by destroying his stratagems!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَحَوِّلْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَنَّا،
phrases.english: 28.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, turn his authority away from us,

phrases.arabic: وَاقْطَعْ رَجَاءَهُ مِنَّا ، وادْرَأْه عَنِ الْوُلُوعِ بِنَا.
phrases.english: 29.cut off his hope from us, and keep him from craving for us!
30.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
31.and place our fathers, our mothers, our children, our wives,
32.our siblings, our relatives, and the faithful among our neighbours,

phrases.arabic: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَـاتِ مِنْهُ فِي حِرْز حَـارِز،
phrases.english: 33.male and female, in a sanctuary impregnable to him,

phrases.arabic: وَحِصْن حَافِظ ، وَكَهْف مَانِع، وَألْبِسْهُمْ مِنْهُ جُنَناً وَاقِيَةً،
phrases.english: 34.a guarding fortress, a defending cave! Clothe them in shields protective against him
35.and give them arms that will cut him down!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذلِكَ مَنْ شَهِدَ لَكَ بِالرُّبُوبِيَّةِ،
phrases.english: 36.O God, include in that everyone who witnesses to You as Lord,
37.devotes himself sincerely to Your Unity,
38.shows enmity toward him through the reality of servanthood,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَظْهَرَ بِكَ عَلَيْهِ فِي مَعْرِفَةِ الْعُلُومِ الرَّبَّانِيَّةِ.
phrases.english: 39.and seeks help from You against him through knowledge of the divine sciences!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْلُلْ مَا عَقَدَ، وَافْتقْ مَا رَتَقَ،
phrases.english: 40.O God, undo what he ties, unstitch what he sews up,

phrases.arabic: وَافسَخ مَا دَبَّرَ، وَثَبِّطْهُ إذَا عَزَمَ، وَانْقُضْ مَا أَبْرَمَ.
phrases.english: 41.dislocate what he devises, frustrate him when he makes up his mind, and destroy what he establishes!
42.O God, rout his troops, nullify his trickery,
43.make his cave collapse, and rub his nose in the ground!
44.O God, place us in the ranks of his enemies
45.and remove us from the number of his friends,
46.that we obey him not when he entices us
47.and answer him not when he calls to us!
48.We command everyone who obeys our command to be his enemy

phrases.arabic: وَنَعِظُ عَنْ مُتَابَعَتِهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ زَجْرَنَا.
phrases.english: 49.and we admonish everyone who follows our prohibition not to follow him!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَسَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
phrases.english: 50.O God, bless Muhammad the Seal of the prophets and lord of the emissaries,
51.and the folk of his house, the good, the pure!
52.Give refuge to us, our families, our brothers,

phrases.arabic: وَجَمِيـعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ مِمَّا اسْتَعَذْنَا مِنْهُ،
phrases.english: 53.and all the faithful, male and female, from that from which we seek refuge,

phrases.arabic: وَأَجِرْنَا مِمَّا اسْتَجَرْنَا بِكَ مِنْ خَوْفِهِ
phrases.english: 54.and grant us sanctuary from that through fear of which we seek sanctuary in You!

phrases.arabic: وَاسْمَعْ لَنَا مَا دَعَوْنَا بِهِ وَأَعْطِنَا مَا أَغْفَلْنَاهُ وَاحْفَظْ لَنَا مَا نَسِيْنَاهُ،
phrases.english: 55.Hear our supplication to You, bestow upon us that of which we have been heedless, and safeguard for us what we have forgotten!
56.Through all this bring us into the ranks of the righteous
57.and the degrees of the faithful!
58.Amen, Lord of the worlds!
